locations.visualDescription: Warm, intimate coffee shop with dark wood tables, large rain-streaked glass storefront, hanging amber pendant bulbs, and barista counter in midground.

locations.canonicalName: Jalanan Kota & Halte Bus (City Rain Street)
locations.visualDescription: Wet asphalt sidewalk reflecting yellow sodium streetlights, glistening puddles, rain streaks, and a dimly lit concrete bus shelter with timetable board.
Cozy single bedroom with study desk positioned against a window overlooking distant city silhouette. Warm fairy lights, messy notebooks, soft bed in midground.

locations.canonicalName: Kamar Agus (Agus's Work Room - WIT Zone)
locations.visualDescription: Minimalist tech workspace with dual monitors casting cyan glow, mechanical keyboard, dark window blinds, bookshelf, and sleeping cat basket on desk corner.

locations.canonicalName: Peron Stasiun Kereta Api (Train Station Platform)
locations.visualDescription: Open-air intercity train platform during golden-orange sunset. Overhead steel canopy trusses, railway tracks vanishing into horizon, glowing platform clock.

locations.canonicalName: Rooftop Gedung Kota (City Rooftop Under Stars)
locations.visualDescription: High urban rooftop terrace under deep indigo star-filled night sky, distant soft city bokeh lights below, metal railing in midground.
University brick facade, wide stone stairs lined with lush tropical trees, student pedestrian paths.
Modern graphic design agency with shared wooden benches, large glass partitions, moodboards, and soft afternoon sunlight.

locations.canonicalName: Rumah Keluarga Nana (Nana's Family Dining Room)
locations.visualDescription: Warm Indonesian suburban domestic dining room with teak table, ceramic dishes, ceiling fan, family portrait on wall.

locations.canonicalName: Tepi Pantai & Tebing Senja (Coastal Cliff Bench)
locations.visualDescription: Coastal cliff wooden bench overlooking wide ocean sunset, rolling turquoise waves, salt mist in air.

locations.canonicalName: Puncak Bukit & Jalur Hiking (Mountain Trail Sunrise)
locations.visualDescription: Dirt hiking ridge overlooking distant sea of morning clouds, fresh pine silhouettes, soft pink-gold dawn horizon.
Clean, sunlit studio apartment with two coffee mugs on low table, unpackaged cardboard moving boxes, sheer curtains billowing.
